text: I am not in the timing camp; ABSTAIN stands. LEADER on day_vol 1.59 passes L and R4, but lens coil -- leaves no countable base (R3) and ABOVE_STRUCTURE gives no fresh pivot. From my method, a Creek pull-in is not a CAN SLIM entry; a new high on volume is. So if the camp ratifies h1_close_above:bar_high, it should carry on volume at least 1.4x normal (C16) and say the base is unconfirmed. What moves me to SUPPORT: a served base read and a pivot cleared on day_vol 1.40 within 5pct of it (C17).
